rationale: The agent located the user by name and ZIP and appears to act on one of the user’s orders, but it executed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the action with the user, which violates the stated policy. Additionally, the final message asserts that a price difference will be refunded without visible supporting tool outputs (no pricing comparison shown), and the product detail lookup (product_id=4760268021) does not clearly correspond to the new_item_id used in the exchange (9844888101), creating an unsupported claim. While basic authentication occurred, the lack of pre-write confirmation alone fails the pass bar.
